get.summary: Report the service's name and the build it is running.
Export one page of an account's custody events, ordered oldest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Absent reads the first page; a value that is not a positive integer is refused 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many events to read. Absent leaves the page size to the ledger; a value that is not an integer is refused 400.

post.summary: Upload images, and the manifests each carries, into a registration slot.

requestBody.description: Zero or more manifest parts followed by the image part they belong to, repeated per image. One image's outcome never refuses its siblings.

items.description: The manifests of the image part that follows. Manifest kind must be 1 to 64 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' or '-'. get.summary: Report every entry a registration slot holds, and what it knows of each.
get.description: Every entry's state is one of: held, registered, answered, failed, errata, retry. "retry" says the engine could not answer that entry yet: nothing was registered, answered or charged for it, and because a commit is terminal this service never re-sends it - the client sends that image again, in a new slot or through the single route.

type.description: The manifest kind exactly as the caller stated it on its part name; validated against no registry.

form.description: The form the payload is carried in, taken from the part's own Content-Type at upload.

payload.description: The payload's own bytes: the JSON object inline and verbatim for form "json", base64 text for form "jumbf".

hash.description: The record's BLAKE3-256 hash over this manifest's STORED bytes, lowercase hex; null on a record that declares none.

signature.description: This manifest's own signature by the registrant's leaf key, base64; null on a record that declares none.

items.description: One manifest off a published record, with the hash and the signature that record declares over it.
